info.title: Omnillink API
info.description: Link intelligence over HTTP: metadata, readable content, typed extraction, tables, screenshots, PDF, page insights, technology detection and small generators (QR code, social card). Every REST endpoint is a `GET`, except the metadata batch; `POST /mcp` exposes the read-only ones to AI agents over the Model Context Protocol. Errors share one JSON shape; a path or method no route serves answers `404 EROUTENOTFOUND`. Query parameters the API does not know are ignored. Rate-limited routes report the caller's quota on every answer (`x-ratelimit-*`), and `429` and `503` answers say how long to wait in `Retry-After`.

post.description: Metadata of up to 10 URLs in one call, over raw HTTP only (the equivalent of `render=never`: no browser). Results come back in input order; a URL that fails yields an error item and never fails the batch. Every URL goes through the same validation and anti-SSRF checks as `GET /api/v1/meta`. The answer is not cacheable by a CDN, but each item reads and feeds the server cache. Rate limit: one tenth of the caller's normal limit, counted separately.

get.description: Responds with the raw image, so the URL can be used directly as an ``. Before the capture the page can be prepared declaratively: hide elements, click one element, scroll to one, wait for a selector. The finished capture can be given a device frame, rounded corners and padding. No script supplied by the caller is ever run.

get.description: Scrapes client-defined fields with CSS selectors (`fields`), or a built-in set of typed fields for an article, a product, a recipe or an event (`preset`). Exactly one of the two is required. With `render=auto`, the browser is used when the page runs scripts and the static markup leaves a field (a key field, for a preset) empty.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the target page.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Required unless `preset` is given. JSON-encoded object mapping a field name to a rule `{ "selector": string, "attr"?: "text" | "html" | <attribute>, "type"?: "string" | "number" | "url", "all"?: boolean }`. At most 20 fields; selectors up to 300 characters. Example: `{"price":{"selector":".price","type":"number"},"links":{"selector":"a","attr":"href","type":"url","all":true}}`.

post.description: MCP server over stateless Streamable HTTP: one JSON-RPC 2.0 message per `POST`, answered as `application/json` (no session, no SSE stream; `GET` answers 405). Methods: `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`. Tools: `meta`, `content`, `extract`, `links`, `tech`, `check`, `sitemap`, `screenshot`. A failed tool call is a normal result with `isError: true` whose text starts with the Omnillink error code (`EBLOCKED: …`). Results are bounded and say when they were cut; anything that comes from a page is announced as third-party data. Rate limited like the REST API (one call = one request) and honours `x-api-key`. A refusal by the HTTP layer (429, 401) is a JSON-RPC error `-32000` whose `data.code` is the Omnillink code.
